title.zh: Papertrade Trader Losses Reach $32.4 Million Two Days After Launch
title.en: Papertrade Trader Losses Reach $32.4 Million Two Days After Launch

current_state.zh: Papertrade, a loss-funded trading venue launched just two days earlier, has seen traders lose $32.4M while its daily revenue surpassed Pump.fun and Hyperliquid, with its house pool holding roughly $4.27M.
